findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done. Lines 650–659 treat any Claude `result` event with exit code 0 as a completed worker round. Claude can emit a successful result with `num_turns: 0`, an empty result, and no assistant message when a prompt is consumed before the model runs; [Claude Code maintainers reproduced that stream](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/80223). In that case `final_result` becomes an empty string, so `forge work` still exits 0. The new command test covers a missing result event, but not this zero-turn result.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Gate. The new refusal tells the coordinator to run Claude interactively to answer a prompt before retrying `forge work`. The repository review rule requires a change to a coordinator's command or step in the flow to update `src/forge/templates/skill.md` or the worker brief in the same change. Neither template is changed, so this recovery step is absent from the shipped guidance.
